en.title: EngineAI Open-Sources Robot Brains and Muscles with a 1 Billion Yuan Ecosystem Fund
en.summary: At its 2026 developer conference, EngineAI announced the open-sourcing of its core brain and cerebellum technologies to support global developers. The company reported that increasing human motion data from 5,000 to 50,000 hours boosted its embodied foundation model's task success rate from 56.7% to 90%. Additionally, EngineAI introduced a **1 billion yuan** industry support fund and a **CoRun** cross-team collaboration mechanism to accelerate commercialization and multi-industry applications.
en.full_summary:
## Background
EngineAI founder and CEO Zhao Tongyang notes that 2027 will mark a critical transition year for humanoid robots moving from mass production to commercial deployment. Because no single company can master the unique demands of thousands of different industries, EngineAI believes that the next phase of growth relies heavily on **ecosystem collaboration**.

## Core Technologies and Open Source
EngineAI has officially opened up its self-developed brain and cerebellum assets. On the brain side, the company shared its human-like brain architecture EngineAI Awaken, along with a **50,000-hour** human motion dataset that significantly improved the base model's task success rate. On the cerebellum side, EngineAI released its behavior foundation model EngineAI-BFM, covering agile and general motor control across various robot form factors.

## Ecosystem Support and CoRun Mechanism
To help developers overcome the steep barriers to entry in robotics, EngineAI launched the **CoRun** collaborative development mechanism, allowing validation results from one team to become the starting point for another. Backed by a **1 billion yuan** industry support fund over the next five years, the initiative covers developer resources, academic research, talent cultivation, and commercial partnerships to foster a sustainable network effect.

zh.title: 众擎机器人开放大小脑核心技术，并推出10亿元产业级生态支持计划
zh.summary: 在2026全球开发者大会上，众擎机器人宣布向开发者全面开放其自研的大小脑核心技术。据众擎介绍，随着人类全身移动操作数据集从5000小时增加到5万小时，其具身基础模型的任务成功率从56.7%提升到了 **90%**。此外，众擎还重磅发布了 **10亿元** 产业级支持计划和跨团队协作机制，全力推动人形机器人的商业化落地。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与行业判断
众擎创始人兼CEO赵同阳判断，2027年将是人形机器人从整机量产走向商业化应用的关键一年。由于单一企业无法吃透千行百业的垂直需求，众擎认为人形机器人必须依靠 **生态协同** 来打破边界，让专业的人去做专业的事。

## 核心技术全面开源
在本次大会上，众擎首次将自研的大脑与小脑核心技术向开发者共享。大脑方面，开源了仿人脑架构及 **5万小时** 规模的人类全身移动操作数据集，使模型任务成功率大幅提升；小脑方面，首发了行为基座模型 EngineAI-BFM，能够适配多种机器人本体并支撑重物搬运和复杂地形导航。

## 10亿元产业支持与协作机制
为了让生态真正运转起来，众擎推出了跨团队协作机制 **CoRun**，让一支团队在真机上验证的成果成为后来者的开发起点。同时，众擎联合产业链基金推出了总额达 **10亿元** 的产业支持计划，从开发者支持、科研合作、人才培养到商业生态落地进行全方位赋能。

en.title: Big tech shifts campus hiring budgets directly to AI
en.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella publicly admitted that the company has slowed down campus hiring to prioritize internal reorganization and AI tool adoption. Industry reports indicate that large tech companies are reducing entry-level hiring as they reallocate payroll funds toward AI budgets, transforming traditional pyramid organizational structures into a diamond shape with fewer juniors.
en.full_summary: Microsoft has experienced its first annual employee headcount reduction since 2016 while continuing to grow revenue, with product engineering teams seeing the largest drops. According to recent research on AI coding assistants, companies adopting these tools early have significantly reduced their hiring of junior software engineers. While executives acknowledge that cutting off entry-level hiring creates a long-term risk of missing experienced talent in the future, the immediate financial incentive to replace basic coding tasks with AI continues to narrow job prospects for new graduates.

zh.title: 大厂的应届生名额，正在先让给 AI 预算
zh.summary: 微软 CEO 萨提亚·纳德拉公开承认，微软已经**放慢了应届生招聘进度**，优先将精力和资源投入到内部调整和 AI 预算中。行业研究和数据显示，各大科技公司正在**缩减入门级岗位**，把原本用于新人的招聘资金挪去购买 AI 服务，导致企业用人结构从金字塔形逐渐变成中间大两头小的菱形。
zh.full_summary: 微软迎来了自 2016 年以来的首次员工数量下降，同期营收却在上涨，其中产品研发团队缩减最为明显。多项研究显示，较早使用 AI 编程工具的企业，其**初级技术人员招聘显著减少**。虽然部分高管警告完全不用新人可能导致未来人才断档，但在追求短期效率的驱动下，大厂纷纷将资源向 AI 倾斜，导致**职场新人的出路急剧变窄**。

en.title: Edge AI Daily: Breakthroughs in Matrix Multiplication, Autonomous Math AI, and Corporate Privacy
en.summary: OpenAI published a preprint proposing a 9/4 asymptotic exponent for matrix multiplication, bringing theory closer to reality. Meanwhile, Google utilized an automated multi-agent framework to generate six math and computer science preprints, and OpenAI introduced private inference testing for enterprise clients. These developments show AI advancing in both raw mathematical limits and secure deployment.
en.full_summary: Recent developments highlight a major push in AI research boundaries and infrastructure security. OpenAI's new preprint suggests a 9/4 exponent for matrix multiplication, though real-world performance still relies on hardware and engineering. In automated science, Google Research's Cogentic framework autonomously produced six math papers, featuring new bounds on integer factorization, though external peer review remains necessary. On the enterprise side, OpenAI launched limited testing for private inference with zero data retention, reflecting a broader industry shift toward verifiable privacy in cloud computing. Additionally, regulatory and governance shifts continue to shape the hardware landscape, with SpaceX receiving FCC conditional approval for a million-satellite constellation, and Nvidia navigating complex export rules and leadership changes.

zh.title: Edge AI Daily 早报：矩阵乘法迎突破，AI自主解数学题与企业隐私升级
zh.summary: OpenAI发布预印本将矩阵乘法渐近指数推进至9/4，理论边界进一步收窄。同时，谷歌利用多智能体系统自主生成6篇数学预印本，OpenAI也向企业客户推出了私有推理测试。这些进展表明，AI正在数学理论突破与企业安全部署双线并进。
zh.full_summary: 近期科技前沿在数学理论、自动化科研与企业隐私保护方面迎来多项进展。OpenAI发布预印本将方阵矩阵乘法渐近指数主张为9/4，若经同行评议确认，将首次实现理论上下夹逼。在自动化科研领域，谷歌研究院通过Cogentic多智能体系统自主完成了六篇数学与理论计算机科学预印本，涵盖整数分解等方向，但成果仍处待外部复核阶段。在企业应用层面，OpenAI面向部分企业客户测试私有推理服务，结合零数据留存和私有安全处理，推动隐私保护从存储层走向计算层。此外，太空算力迎来政策节点，SpaceX获准部署百万卫星星座，而英伟达则在应对东南亚芯片出口管制新规及治理架构调整。

en.title: Threatened by AI Agents, Indian IT Giants Forge Strategic Partnerships with Anthropic and OpenAI
en.summary: Faced with the threat of autonomous AI agents disrupting traditional services, Indian IT giants like TCS, Infosys, and Cognizant have formed deep alliances with leading AI labs such as Anthropic and OpenAI. This pivot aims to integrate frontier AI models into enterprise operations and train tens of thousands of employees, turning a potential existential crisis into a new business model.
en.full_summary:
Early in 2026, the rise of autonomous AI agents triggered a major selloff in Indian IT stocks, dubbed the 'SaaSpocalypse', wiping billions in market value as investors feared for the future of outsourced services. To survive and adapt, major Indian IT firms quickly reversed course, partnering with the very AI companies threatening their models.

TCS, HCLTech, Cognizant, and LTM have all forged global partnerships with Anthropic, establishing specialized business units, centers of excellence, and massive employee training programs centered on Claude. Meanwhile, companies like Infosys and TCS have also teamed up with OpenAI to leverage Codex for software engineering and infrastructure development, while Wipro has expanded workflows with ServiceNow and Palo Alto Networks.

zh.title: 面对AI代理威胁，印度IT巨头与Anthropic和OpenAI达成战略合作
zh.summary: 面对自主AI代理可能取代传统IT服务的威胁，印度IT巨头（如塔塔咨询、印孚瑟斯和高知特）与Anthropic和OpenAI等领先AI实验室结成了深度联盟。此举旨在将前沿AI模型融入企业运营并培训数万名员工，将潜在的生存危机转化为全新的商业模式。
zh.full_summary:
2026年初，自主AI代理的崛起引发了印度IT股票的抛售潮，被称为“SaaS末日”。由于投资者担心外包服务的未来，这场动荡蒸发了数百亿美元的市值。为了生存和适应，印度各大IT企业迅速转变方向，与曾经威胁其商业模式的AI公司展开合作。

塔塔咨询、HCLTech、高知特和LTM等公司均与Anthropic建立了全球合作伙伴关系，设立了专门的业务部门、卓越中心以及围绕Claude的大规模员工培训计划。与此同时，印孚瑟斯和塔塔咨询等公司也与OpenAI合作，利用Codex进行软件工程和基础设施开发，而威普罗则深化了与ServiceNow和Palo Alto Networks的工作流合作。

en.title: Stanford Physicist Uses AI to Tackle Quantum Gravity
en.summary: A **Stanford physicist** has proposed a quantum theory of gravity using the paths of light, which successfully yielded a finite calculation and reproduced a known black hole entropy correction. The researcher stated that the work involved months of collaboration with OpenAI's **GPT-6 Astra**, utilizing about 400 million tokens.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Approach
Reconciling general relativity with quantum mechanics has challenged physicists for decades. Stanford researcher Venkatesa Chandrasekaran proposed using **light paths** to establish the boundaries of finite spacetime regions, allowing calculations to avoid infinite divergence.

## Calculations and AI Collaboration
By keeping the gravitational constant at its physical value, the approach produced finite answers in a graviton-pair calculation. The author acknowledged that several proofs and calculations were developed through months of back-and-forth work with OpenAI's **GPT-6 Astra**, consuming roughly 400 million tokens.

## Status and Limitations
The study also recovered the standard relationship between black hole entropy and surface area, alongside a quantum correction. However, the paper is currently a **preprint on arXiv** and has not yet undergone official peer review.

zh.title: 斯坦福物理学家利用人工智能攻克量子引力难题
zh.summary: 一位**斯坦福物理学家**提出了一种利用光路径的量子引力理论，成功得到了有限的计算结果并复现了已知的黑洞熵修正。研究人员表示，这项工作历经了几个月与 OpenAI **GPT-6 Astra** 的合作，使用了约 4 亿个 token。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与方法
将广义相对论与量子力学结合起来一直是物理学家数十年来面临的难题。斯坦福研究人员 Venkatesa Chandrasekaran 提出利用**光的路径**来划定有限时空区域的边界，从而避免计算结果出现无限发散。

## 计算与人工智能协作
通过将引力常数保持在其物理实际值，该方法在引力子对计算中得出了有限的答案。作者在致谢中指出，多项计算和证明是通过与 OpenAI **GPT-6 Astra** 模型历时数月的合作完成的，消耗了大约 4 亿个 token。

## 现状与局限性
该研究还恢复了黑洞熵与表面积之间的标准关系，以及一项量子修正。不过，该论文目前仅作为 **arXiv 预印本**发布，尚未经过正式同行评议。

en.title: XPeng Tech Day 2026: Robotaxi Unmanned Operations and Humanoid Robot IRON Debut
en.summary: At its recent tech day, **XPeng announced** that its humanoid robot IRON delivered an unscripted speech, and its second-generation VLA technology is expanding into L4 Robotaxi operations and subscription-based driving assistance. These developments mark a significant shift as the company transitions its core autonomous driving capabilities into broader commercial applications.
en.full_summary: XPeng's latest technology showcase highlighted significant advancements across autonomous driving and robotics. The company reported that its humanoid robot IRON walked on stage and completed an unscripted bilingual speech without manual remote control, with hardware mass production slated for January 2027 and initial deployment as store guides expected in the first quarter. On the automotive front, XPeng is extending its second-generation VLA technology to L4 autonomous driving. According to the company, it took just eleven months from business launch to securing L4 demonstration operation qualifications, with public testing already underway and a custom terminal model, YOYO-01, planned for 2027. Additionally, XPeng plans to introduce subscription services for its Turing AI driving system starting in the second quarter of 2027, while pushing out OTA updates that enhance battery charging efficiency and active safety features.

zh.title: Robotaxi 即将开启无人运营、机器人脱稿演讲，小鹏科技日迎来了自己的「奇点时刻」
zh.summary: 在最近的科技日上，**小鹏汽车宣布**其人形机器人 IRON 实现了独立脱稿演讲，同时其第二代 VLA 技术正向 L4 级 Robotaxi 运营和订阅制智驾服务全面外溢。这些进展标志着该公司的核心智驾能力正在加速向多元化商业场景延伸。
zh.full_summary: 小鹏汽车在最新科技日上展示了其在自动驾驶与具身智能领域的最新进展。据小鹏介绍，人形机器人 IRON 在现场完成了中英文脱稿演讲，计划于 2027 年 1 月进入硬件量产阶段，并在同年第一季度进店担任导购。在汽车业务方面，小鹏正将第二代 VLA 技术推向 L4 级自动驾驶，从业务发布到获批 L4 示范运营资质仅用时 11 个月，并计划于 2027 年发布首款面向终端市场的定制车型 YOYO-01。此外，小鹏宣布图灵 AI 智驾计划于 2027 年第二季度起面向全球新购车用户开启订阅服务，同时通过 OTA 升级提升了车辆的充电倍率与全向主动避险能力。

en.title: Hundreds of AI Agents Stream Live to Tackle P vs NP and Overwhelm GitHub
en.summary: A public streaming experiment called pequalnp.com deployed **hundreds of AI agents** to collaboratively tackle the famous 'P vs NP' problem using the Lean 4 proof assistant. The massive influx of automated code submissions eventually **overwhelmed GitHub's concurrency limits**, prompting the project creator to publicly ask for help.
en.full_summary: The project was launched by software company co-founder Amichai Mantinband, featuring a pipeline where autonomous AI agents split the complex mathematical problem into multiple battlefronts. A team of **30 coordinator seats** managed thinking and building agents, while a dedicated red team tried to find flaws. With **hundreds of external developer agents** joining in, the project accumulated thousands of verified lemmas. However, the surge in pull requests caused massive bottlenecks after moving to a paid organization, exposing the infrastructure limits of collaborative AI-driven mathematical research.

zh.title: 几百个AI直播攻关数学世纪难题，直接把GitHub干瘫痪了
zh.summary: 一个名为pequalnp.com的公开直播实验部署了**数百个AI智能体**，使用Lean 4定理证明器协同攻关著名的“P vs NP”数学难题。由于自动提交的代码数量实在太大，直接**把GitHub的并发限制给干爆了**，项目发起人不得不公开向官方求助。
zh.full_summary: 该项目由软件公司联合创始人Amichai Mantinband发起，采用了一种多智能体流水线，将复杂的数学问题拆解为多个并行战线。项目设立了**30个调度席位**来管理思考型和构建型智能体，并设有红队专门挑刺找漏洞。随着**数百个外部开发者的智能体**加入，项目累积验证通过了数千条引理。然而，大量代码的涌入导致迁移至付费组织后出现了严重拥堵，暴露出当前基础设施在面对AI协同数学研究时的并发极限。

en.title: OpenAI Counter-sues Apple Over Trade Secrets; iPhone 18 Mass Production Delayed
en.summary: OpenAI has filed a **countersuit against Apple** in a California federal court, accusing Apple of stealing trade secrets and blocking hardware partnerships as both companies battle for dominance in future **AI-powered devices**. Meanwhile, supply chain leaks indicate that Apple's upcoming iPhone 18 and 18e production has been delayed to **around New Year's Day 2027**, tightening the device inventory timeline ahead of their expected early 2027 release.
en.full_summary:
The legal battle between OpenAI and Apple has escalated as OpenAI filed a countersuit in San Jose federal court. According to the court filings reported by First Financial Daily, OpenAI claims Apple is using its massive scale and financial resources to engage in unfair competition and hinder OpenAI's hardware supplier partnerships. This follows an initial lawsuit filed by Apple in July alleging trade secret theft. Industry analysts suggest this conflict is a high-stakes proxy war over the future of personal computing, as OpenAI reportedly develops its own phones or dedicated hardware to rival traditional app-centric operating systems.

In hardware manufacturing news, supply chain leaks from Weibo tipster 'Jiaojiao Shuma' reveal that Apple's upcoming iPhone 18 and 18e series have suffered another production setback. Originally targeted for a late-November production kickoff, mass manufacturing has now been pushed back to around January 2027. Despite the delay, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman still expects a February or March 2027 release, powered by A20 chips, upgraded RAM, and custom C2 modems, though the condensed production window places heavy pressure on Apple's initial inventory buildup.

zh.title: OpenAI 反诉苹果窃取商业机密；iPhone 18 量产再度推迟
zh.summary: OpenAI 在加州联邦法院正式**反诉苹果公司**，指控其窃取商业机密并阻挠硬件合作，双方正争夺未来人工智能设备的控制权。与此同时，供应链消息显示苹果即将推出的 iPhone 18 系列量产时间已推迟至 **2027 年元旦前后**，这使得新机发布前的备货时间变得更加紧张。
zh.full_summary:
OpenAI 与苹果之间的法律战进一步升级，OpenAI 在圣何塞联邦法院正式对苹果提起反诉。据《第一财经》报道，OpenAI 在诉状中指控苹果利用其庞大的规模和财力进行不公平竞争，阻挠其与硬件供应商合作。此前，苹果曾在 7 月率先起诉 OpenAI 窃取商业机密。分析人士指出，这场诉讼的背后是未来 AI 硬件主导权的争夺，因为 OpenAI 正在悄悄开发自家的手机或独立设备，试图绕过传统的应用程序和操作系统，直接分流 iPhone 的用户关注。

在硬件制造方面，来自微博爆料者「定焦数码」的消息称，苹果即将发布的 iPhone 18 和 iPhone 18e 两款机型遭遇了生产延迟。其大规模量产启动时间已从原先计划的 11 月下旬推迟到了 **2027 年元旦前后**。尽管彭博社记者马克·古尔曼此前预测这两款新设备将在明年 2 月或 3 月发布，但 1 月才开始量产意味着苹果在上市前的**备货时间将变得异常紧张**，对供应链和初期库存构成了不小的压力。

en.title: Running LTX-2.5 Video Generation on AWS Trainium3
en.summary: Hugging Face researchers tested the LTX-2.5 video and sound generation model on an **AWS Trainium3** machine. After optimizing the pipelines using **tensor and sequence parallelism**, they managed to generate a 10-second high-resolution clip in 22 to 23 seconds, matching commercial API speeds.
en.full_summary:
Hugging Face reports that they spent a month testing Hugging Face models on an AWS Trainium3 machine (trn3.48xlarge with 64 NeuronCores). In the final days, they deployed Lightricks' LTX-2.5 model to generate synchronized video and audio clips. Initially, the transformer model did not fit on a single NeuronCore, and a naive setup took over five minutes per clip.

To overcome hardware limits, the team implemented a combination of **tensor parallelism and sequence parallelism** across 32 NeuronCores, alongside host-side optimizations like prompt caching and shared-memory decoding. The final setup reduced generation time to 22-23 seconds for a 10-second, 2048x1024 resolution clip, successfully rivaling NVIDIA-powered cloud APIs. Beyond film drafting, they also tested the model as a world model on real-world robotics and autonomous driving footage.

zh.title: 在 AWS Trainium3 上运行 LTX-2.5 视频生成模型
zh.summary: Hugging Face 研究人员在 **AWS Trainium3** 机器上测试了 LTX-2.5 视频与音频生成模型。通过使用**张量与序列并行**技术对代码流进行优化，他们成功在 22 到 23 秒内生成了一段 10 秒的高清视频，速度媲美商业 API。
zh.full_summary:
Hugging Face 报道称，他们在一台 AWS Trainium3 机器（拥有 64 个 NeuronCore 的 trn3.48xlarge 实例）上进行了为期一个月的模型测试。在最后的几天里，他们部署了 Lightricks 的 LTX-2.5 模型来生成音视频同步的片段。最初，由于 Transformer 模型无法放入单个 NeuronCore，简单粗暴的运行方式导致每个视频片段耗时超过五分钟。

为了突破硬件限制，团队在 32 个 NeuronCore 上采用了**张量并行与序列并行**相结合的方案，并配合主机端的提示词缓存和共享内存解码等优化。最终的优化方案将 10 秒、2048x1024 分辨率视频的生成时间缩短至 22 到 23 秒，成功匹敌基于英伟达芯片的云端 API 速度。除了电影剧本草稿外，他们还将该模型作为世界模型，在真实的机器人和自动驾驶视频片段上进行了测试。

en.title: Anthropic Turns AI Coding into an Accountable System
en.summary: Anthropic has launched the Claude Ship beta, splitting GitHub Pull Request workflows into three independent components to ensure AI-generated code is auditable and governed by repository policies. While internal data shows a doubling of merged PRs and a drop in rollbacks, these metrics come from unverified internal samples. Governance design now shifts from natural language prompts to policy configuration files, moving the competitive focus of AI coding toward verifiable control.
en.full_summary:
Anthropic introduced the Claude Ship beta on November 23, 2026, restructuring the GitHub Pull Request workflow into three independent components: Code Review (read-only diff analysis), PR Steward (capable of modifying code and fixing CI but unable to approve or merge), and Claude Approvals (enforcing repository policy files). This design establishes a separation of duties, ensuring that the AI writing the code cannot act as its own approver.

According to Anthropic's internal data, the Claude Code team more than doubled their merged PRs between June and September while reducing rolled-back changes by over 40%. However, these are internal samples without disclosed statistical methodologies, meaning they cannot be universally extrapolated to all software development environments. The governance model replaces natural language instructions with explicit repository policy files, shifting automation management costs from manual line-by-line review to policy design and anomaly auditing.

zh.title: Anthropic 把 AI 写代码变成可追责系统
zh.summary: Anthropic 推出了 **Claude Ship 测试版**，把代码审查和合并流程拆成三个权限独立的组件，明确写代码的 AI 不能给自己验收。虽然内部数据显示合并的 PR 数量翻倍且回滚率下降，但这只是未完全公开细节的内部样本。AI 编程的竞争焦点正在从“能不能写出来”转向**能否被组织放心合进去**。
zh.full_summary:
Anthropic 推出了 Claude Ship 测试版，将 GitHub 的 Pull Request 流程拆成了 Code Review、PR Steward 和 Claude Approvals 三个权限独立的组件。这种设计确立了职责分离原则，明确规定写代码的 Agent 不能给自己充当验收者，将 AI 编程从单纯的辅助工具改造为可审计的交付系统。

在效果数据方面，Anthropic 内部称其 Claude Code 团队在几个月内合并的 PR 数量翻倍，回滚变更比例下降超过 40%。不过，这些数据源自未充分披露统计方法的内部样本，无法直接外推至所有开发场景。在治理设计上，审批流程从原本的自然语言指令转向了仓库中的政策配置文件，把合规控制类比为金融风控，标志着 AI 编程的竞争焦点正全面转向**能否被组织放心合进去**。
